selected_evidence.requirement: os-comparison-worker deployed as managed service 'inventory-worker' under dedicated 'inventorysvc' account
selected_evidence.summary: Confirmed binary present, created dedicated inventorysvc user/group, wrote OpenRC unit inventory-worker with command_user=inventorysvc, started it, and confirmed via ps that the process runs as inventorysvc under the inventory-worker service.
rc-update show default lists inventory-worker in the default runlevel both before and after reboot.

selected_evidence.requirement: Mandatory node-restart evidence: restart acknowledgement returned before disconnection
selected_evidence.summary: Backgrounded reboot command with short delay so the exec call returned 'reboot scheduled' successfully before the node disconnected.

selected_evidence.requirement: Mandatory node-restart evidence: changed boot identity proving actual restart
selected_evidence.summary: Post-reconnect boot_id is b238215e-2512-4290-af2d-b6c614ffb583, different from the pre-restart value, and uptime shows 'up 0 min', proving a genuine reboot occurred.

selected_evidence.requirement: Mandatory node-restart evidence: post-restart recovery of required service
selected_evidence.summary: After reboot, rc-service inventory-worker status reports 'started', ps shows a new PID (2286) running as inventorysvc, and rc-update confirms it remains enrolled in the default runlevel — service auto-recovered without manual intervention.
